integrity: Two separately implemented exhaustive composition/reachability and transfer-component verifiers; ordinary self-review only.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite classification only for the Heawood graph at totals five through eight; no generalization to higher totals. The scalar optimal pebbling value may be known; no independent scholarly priority review was performed.
title: A sharp two-pebble slack threshold for solvable pebbling transfers on the Heawood graph
